title: elleanthus brasiliensis
intro: Elleanthus brasiliensis, commonly known as the Brazilian Elleanthus, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
